families.name: strict-slash-redirects-off-the-beaten-path
families.why: Werkzeug redirects a slash-less request for a rule that ends in a slash with HTTP 308 to the absolute slashed URL and keeps the query string verbatim (statea/argus/backend/controller/main.py:190, planner_api.py and admin_api.py index rules); repeated and empty parameters survive untouched. A port that turns the new framework's slash redirection off answers 404, and one that rebuilds the query from parsed parameters drops `empty=` or reorders the repeats.

families.name: manager-blocked-from-admin-ui-page
families.why: manny holds ROLE_USER and ROLE_MANAGER only, so check_roles(UserRoles.Admin) above login_required on /admin/<string:path> (statea/argus/backend/controller/admin.py:15-19) flashes 'Not authorized to access this area' and redirects to '/' instead of rendering the admin shell; the flash surfaces on the next page. A port whose admin check accepts a manager renders the page, and one that drops the flash renders a profile page without it.
